reply.analysis: Proven: bracket [39, 39] for 780 receivers. The lower bound is an independent set of size 39; the upper bound is a linear code over F_2 with c = 1 (M = I + A), named by the Kneser (40, 2) rule and passing code_fits, factorization and decoding checks, after one code tried. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha (14.0 s) and CP-SAT cover (36.1 s) also reached 39 and proved it; the earlier kushagra_agent also got 39 in 0.24 s, faster than this agent (wall 25.9 s, of which llm_s 25.8 s; compute_s only 0.133 s). Fractional cover (41.27) was unproven at the 121 s limit; F2 minrank SAT only gave 38. Nothing suspicious, but LLM time dominates and cost the speed comparison.
